findings.title: The newly documented exit-code contract is not asserted
findings.body: The disabled-feature test only checks stderr and does not assert that the process exits with code 4. Likewise, the incompatible-version cases only check their messages and do not assert the newly changed recreate exit code 3. These numeric exit codes are explicitly documented for automation, so a regression in `picocli.exit(...)` handling or the constants would pass this suite while breaking GitOps/CI consumers. Assert the exit codes for disabled metadata/check commands and for incompatible checks.
